unit.scope: Uniform wet disc, four-axis paired donor graph with equal edges; omits actual GPU pressure/capacity/noise. Harmonics describe this conditional oracle only.

dyadic.scope: Uniform wet disc, four-axis paired donor graph with equal edges; omits actual GPU pressure/capacity/noise. Harmonics describe this conditional oracle only.

clamp.scope: Mean-downsample radial Gaussian, conservative redistributed low mass, literal scalar base+bilerp(delta) clamp; not actual four-tap GPU source/pressure.
